dataset_metadata.name: EVERLASTING D2.3 – Aging test profiles and test results on commercial 18650 Li-ion cell (LGChem INR18650 MJ1)
dataset_metadata.institution: VITO/EnergyVille; TUV SUD Battery Testing GmbH
dataset_metadata.citation: Trad, K.; Govindarajan, J. (2020). D2.3 – Report containing aging test profiles and test results. EVERLASTING Project (H2020 Grant Agreement No 713771), VITO/EnergyVille.
dataset_metadata.funding: European Commission Horizon 2020, grant agreement No 713771 (EVERLASTING: Electric Vehicle Enhanced Range, Lifetime And Safety Through INGenious battery management)

cell_info.cell_notes: Voltage window 2.5–4.2 V per manufacturer datasheet. Cell chemistry confirmed by project analysis: Ni-rich NMC811 positive electrode and Si/graphite-based negative electrode.

aging_modes.notes: Dataset comprises three test campaigns: (1) lifecycle cycling with continuous CC-CV charge and CC discharge at varied C-rates and temperatures (VITO at 25°C/45°C on PEC tester; TUV SUD at 0°C/10°C on Maccor tester); (2) lifecycle cycling with real driving profiles recorded by VOLTIA from their electric van (TUV SUD at 0°C/5°C/10°C on Scienlab tester; VITO at 25°C/45°C on PEC tester); (3) calendar aging at OCV at fixed SOC and temperature (VITO at 25°C/45°C; TUV SUD at 0°C/10°C). All conditions use 2 replicate cells. Life cycling tests at 0°C and 10°C were interrupted for laboratory renovation (100+ cumulative days of uncontrolled rest) and were not restarted. 3C discharge at 45°C was stopped due to over-temperature alarms (cell surface exceeded 55°C). Total: 70 cells across 35 unique conditions (9 drive profile + 14 lifecycle + 12 calendar), per Deliverable D2.3 Tables 1-4.

time_protocol.test_equipment: PEC battery tester (VITO); Maccor battery tester (TUV SUD lifecycle); Scienlab battery tester (TUV SUD drive profile)
time_protocol.notes: Life cycling tests lasted around 350 days at time of report writing (February 2020). Calendar aging data shown up to ~425 days. EOL (80% SoH) was reached by only 4 cells (at 25°C and 45°C) within the observation period. Cells cycling at 0°C reached EOL after 286 equivalent cycles.

rawdata.data_quality_notes: VITO lifecycle files are large single-cell AllData CSV files (~400–800 MB each). TUV SUD files are split into multiple sequential segment files (~65–100 MB each, up to 6 per cell). Total unzipped size: ~2.9 GB (TUV dataset, 44 files) and ~9.7 GB (VITO dataset, 19 files).
rawdata.known_issues: Lifecycle tests at 0°C and 10°C (TUV SUD) were interrupted for 100+ cumulative days due to laboratory renovation; cells showed anomalous behavior (extended CV phase, apparent capacity above nominal) and tests were discontinued. 3C discharge cycling at 45°C was stopped due to over-temperature alarms.

checkup.notes: Two check-up types used: Short Check-Up (SCU) performed at regular intervals; Extended Check-Up (ECU) performed at start, mid-life, and end (SoH=80%). Both include a nominal 1C capacity test and 30-second 1C charge/discharge pulse tests at multiple SOC levels. ECU additionally includes a DST test, C/20 capacity test, and discharge capacity tests at C/5, C/2, and 2C. A stabilization period of 8–24 hours is applied before and after each check-up. Check-ups performed at 25°C. SOC cycling window updated after each check-up using the latest discharge capacity value.

notes: This dataset is the output of the EVERLASTING H2020 EU project (Grant No 713771, 01/09/2016–31/08/2020). It covers three aging campaigns on the LGChem INR18650 MJ1 cell: (1) continuous CC-CV lifecycle cycling at varied C-rates and temperatures, (2) drive-profile cycling using real VOLTIA e-van profiles at varied temperatures, and (3) calendar aging at OCV at three SOC levels and four temperatures. Data is hosted across multiple 4TU.ResearchData sub-datasets: lifecycle at 25°C/45°C (DOI: 10.4121/13739296), lifecycle at 0°C/10°C (DOI: 10.4121/14377295), and the main collection (DOI: 10.4121/14377184). A Mendeley mirror is also available at https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/kw34hhw7xg/3. Drive cycle profiles are custom real-world recordings from the VOLTIA electric van (city pattern for 70–90% SOC window; combined city/highway/intermediate for 10–90% SOC window).
